name: GroundingPI Perception Studio
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Independent English frontend owned by GroundingPI. The original purple and lime palette, Manrope font, nine task routes and 22 image examples are preserved. Video remains disabled.

This Static Space does not host model weights or allocate GPUs. An inference service must be configured in backend.json. No owner token or credentials are stored in the page. Only the current image, query and task are sent when the user presses Run Grounding. Browsing examples does not run inference.

The configured backend is FanLR/GroundingPI at The previous FanLR/GroundingPI-4B repository address now redirects to this renamed Space. Its /chooseupload endpoint binds an uploaded image to the frontend client's Gradio session, and /runconsole takes the query and task. No backend code changes are required. The model is GroundingPI/GroundingPI. The backend must be public for unauthenticated frontend access. API calls currently use anonymous ZeroGPU quota; no owner token is used, and merely signing in on the Hub does not authenticate these API requests.
